title: Job Openings at Techyta
content:
Techyta is a technology-focused learning academy providing practical training in IT, programming, digital skills, and emerging technologies for all age groups.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Assistant Tutor 

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

??????Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a motivated, enthusiastic, and tech-savvy Assistant Tutor to support lead tutors in delivering engaging and practical technology lessons.
	The successful candidate will assist students during learning sessions and contribute to creating a positive and supportive learning environment.


Core Responsibilities


	Assist lead tutors in delivering IT, technology, and programming lessons.
	Support students during practical sessions, exercises, and projects.
	Prepare lesson materials, notes, practical exercises, and other learning resources.
	Provide individual and group support to students.
	Monitor students’ participation, progress, and performance.
	Maintain accurate attendance and student records.
	Encourage creativity, problem-solving, teamwork, and active participation.
	Help maintain a safe, engaging, and conducive learning environment.
	Support classroom activities and other academic tasks as assigned by management.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Education, or a related field.
	1–2 years of experience in teaching, tutoring, mentoring, or a related role.
	Basic knowledge of programming, IT tools, and digital platforms.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work effectively with children and teenagers.
	Passion for technology education and learning.
	Ability to work collaboratively with lead tutors and management.
	Relevant IT, programming, or teaching certifications are an added advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Communication
	Patience & Supportiveness
	Problem-Solving
	Attention to Detail
	Teamwork
	Tech-Savviness
	Organisation
	Initiative.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using "Assistant Tutor – Techyta" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

2.) Front Desk Officer / Course Advisor

Job Location: Asokoro, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a professional, proactive, and customer-focused Front Desk Officer to serve as the first point of contact for parents, students, visitors, and prospective clients.


Core Responsibilities


	Attend to parents, students, visitors, and prospective clients professionally.
	Handle enquiries via phone calls, WhatsApp, email, and other official channels.
	Provide information about Techyta’s courses, curriculum, schedules, fees, registration, and learning process.
	Explain the programmes for Basic 1–6, JSS 1–3, and SS 1–3.
	Manage student registration and support onboarding.
	Follow up with prospective parents and students.
	Maintain accurate student and enquiry records.
	Receive and escalate enquiries or concerns to the appropriate team.
	Support daily front-desk and administrative activities.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree/HND in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Office Administration, Marketing, Education, or a related discipline.
	1–3 years’ experience in reception, customer service, administration, admissions, or a similar role.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and digital communication platforms.
	Proactive, organised, professional, and customer-focused.
	Ability to communicate effectively with children and adults.
	Basic knowledge or interest in technology and digital learning is an added advantage.
	Relevant professional certification is an added advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Communication | Customer Service | Organisation | Proactiveness | Professionalism | Problem-Solving | Teamwork.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using "Receptionist –Techyta" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

3.) IT, Technology & Programming Tutor 

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	
	We are seeking experienced and passionate IT, Technology & Programming Tutors to deliver engaging, practical, and age-appropriate technology education to our students.
	


Core Responsibilities


	Deliver IT, technology, coding, and programming lessons based on Techyta’s curriculum.
	Teach students across Basic, JSS, SS and A/AS levels using age-appropriate methods.
	Prepare lesson plans, lesson notes, practical exercises, projects, and assessments.
	Simplify technical concepts and create an engaging learning environment.
	Monitor and assess students’ progress and provide feedback.
	Maintain attendance, assessment, and student performance records.
	Encourage creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and innovation.
	Collaborate with management and other tutors to ensure effective curriculum delivery.
	Stay updated with relevant technology trends and tools.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Education Technology, or a related field.
	Minimum 4 years of teaching experience in IT, technology, computer science, or programming.
	Strong knowledge of relevant programming languages and technology tools.
	Excellent communication, teaching, and classroom management skills.
	Ability to teach and engage children and teenagers effectively.
	Relevant IT, programming, or teaching certifications are an added advantage.
	Experience in schools, coding academies, or technology training centres is an advantage.


Areas of Expertise:


	Programming
	Python
	JavaScript
	HTML/CSS
	Web Development
	Scratch | Robotics
	AI | Data Science
	SQL | UI/UX
	Cybersecurity
	Computer Science
	Digital Literacy.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using "IT/Technology Tutor – Techyta" as the subject of the email.

Note


	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
	Please indicate your area of expertise.
    

    

        Click here to Apply

IT Support Officer Job at Virgin Forest Energy Limited




        
    

        
        Virgin Forest Energy Limited is a wholly-owned and well capitalized Nigerian energy downstream oil trading company. We are dedicated to the provision of top-rate petroleum products and by-products to our vast array of clients and customers across Nigeria and beyond. In the course of our short but eventful existence as a corporate entity, we have carved a niche for ourselves as a company sensitive to the peculiar environment in which we operate, and we have tailored our operations in response to the ever-changing demands of a vibrant and dynamic emerging economy such as Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: IT Support Officer

Job Location: Lagos
     

            
    



Job Summary


	We are looking an IT Officer who will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the firm’s IT systems (hardware maintenance, network connectivity, and software support).
	This role is ideal for a candidate with hands-on expertise in hardware troubleshooting and a solid understanding of enterprise applications within the financial services industry.


Key Responsibilities


	Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other peripherals.
	Diagnose and resolve hardware faults and system malfunctions promptly; provide technical assistance to staff across all departments.
	Perform routine checks on all IT equipment and coordinate repairs/replacements with approved vendors.
	Provide support for LAN/WAN connectivity and troubleshoot issues related to routers, switches, and access points.
	Assist in monitoring network security, ensure adherence to IT security policies, and support data backup/disaster recovery processes.
	Assist the Head of IT in monitoring system performance and escalating complex software issues when necessary.
	Maintain the highest standards of data protection regarding sensitive financial and client information.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
	2–3 years of hands-on experience in IT support
	Strong expertise in hardware troubleshooting; familiarity with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Windows Server environments.
	Excellent analytical problem-solving abilities, strong communication skills, and a high level of integrity.


Method of Applictaion 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
